## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes (lint, format, types, offline tests)
- [ ] New behaviour has tests; security-relevant changes have a regression test in `tests/test_security.py`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] If a defensive check was relaxed, the reasoning is stated in the PR body
- [ ] I am the author of this change and can stand behind it in review. If an AI
      tool helped write it, I have read and understood the result, and no AI is
      credited as an author or co-author (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
